Card.title: Player card
Card.lead: Hover over the card or tap it to flip it.
bio: From Talas, lives in Bishkek. Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk.
Graduated from college in information security, so he thinks not only about how a form looks but also about what someone might send through it. Now studying business informatics at university.
Has already closed backend tasks on a work project — and liked it. Wants to make that position his own.

Scout.title: Scouting report
Scout.strengths: Careful typing, layouts that fit any screen, accessible interfaces, fast-loading pages, Feature-Sliced Design architecture and an eye for form security.
Scout.growing: Backend: Node.js and NestJS, Java, SQL and PostgreSQL, API design and working with databases.
Scout.note: Sometimes sweats the small stuff: a stray pixel in the layout, a variable name. The coaching staff ask him not to hold on to the ball.

Match.title: Career as a match
Match.lead: Scroll down: the clock on the scoreboard runs with you.
fouls: Yellow card to Bugs for diving: “works on my machine”.
Second yellow, that’s red! Bugs are sent off. Until the next release.
Bugs are already in the dressing room. The referee asks not to disturb them.
commentary: Alisher beats three bugs and is one on one with production!
The referee shows a yellow card for !important in CSS.
VAR is checking: bug or feature? Feature. Play on.
Trusts the team, but re-checks staging after them — and is right more often than the backend would like.
The coach shouts from the touchline: “Type it!”
The ball hits the post. The post turns out to be legacy code.
Match stats: zero console.log in production. Almost.

academy.title: Peaksoft academy

peaksoft.title: First-team debut: Peaksoft
peaksoft.text: Intern, then Junior Frontend. A gadget store, clinic bookings, an English testing platform. Taught students on the side.
did: Contributed to 6 production-grade products (10k+ users across marketplace, e-commerce, booking, education, and testing domains) by implementing multi-channel lead capture, optimizing checkout/booking flows, and integrating trust-building elements (social proof, testimonials, real-time metrics).

Scaled education platform for 2,000+ students - increased engagement by 40%, teacher productivity by 30%, through rich content tools (3 WYSIWYG editors), interactive tests, automated grading, and real-time progress analytics.

Implemented security-critical systems with advanced anti-fraud - reduced cheating attempts by 40%, maintained 15% sign-up growth, through PrintScreen blocking, tab-switch detection (Visibility API), dual storage (Redux + sessionStorage), and compliance-ready admin pipeline.

Accelerated frontend performance across all products - 60% faster load time, WCAG accessibility, multi-language SEO (KY/RU/EN), high Lighthouse scores, integrated Stripe payments, Firebase Auth, CircleCI deployment - zero critical bugs.

Empowered non-technical teams with self-service admin panels - enabled marketers, teachers, and moderators to manage content, schedules, and moderation independently without developer involvement or redeploys.
Reduced cart abandonment on e-commerce platform: implemented Stripe checkout with auto-fill, real-time validation via Formik + Yup; delivered production-ready payment flow independently.
Accelerated catalog load time by 60%: leveraged code splitting with React.lazy() + debounced search, skeleton screens, and 96+ memoizations; optimized performance despite handling 1000+ products.

Simplified product management for team: built Admin Dashboard with bulk operations, multi-step wizard, and drag-and-drop image uploads; enabled non-technical team to manage inventory without developer help.
Increased retention: implemented wishlist, browsing history, product comparison, and smart recommendations with Redux Persist; shipped features that directly improved user engagement metrics.

codify.title: Transfer to Codify Lab
codify.text: Lead author of Codify GO: interactive coding lessons, points and levels, certificates, payments. Plus a student LMS and reports for curators.
did: Contributed to 6 educational products, developing new features for Codify GO, CRM, Academy, Job Codify, Startup Nation, and internal learning platforms.
Automated teacher reporting and parent communication via WhatsApp, reducing report preparation time by 50% through a Smart Reports system with editable tables and retry mechanisms.
Increased student engagement by 30–40% using gamification features - implemented XP progression, leaderboards, Code Coins as real rewards, and competitive challenges across all platforms.
Monetized education via Stripe subscriptions - implemented monthly/yearly plans (17% savings for annual), Pro content paywalls, and promo code systems without reducing free-tier user growth.

Achieved high performance and conversion metrics - 96% Lighthouse score on desktop, 95%+ on mobile, increased lead conversion by 15%, and reduced bounce rate by 20% through multi-channel lead capture and segmented funnels.

clickfood.title: Transfer to ClickFood
clickfood.text: Middle Frontend. Food delivery as a Telegram Mini App: catalogue and cart for customers, a restaurant dashboard, reports for accounting.
did: Developed a Telegram Mini App for food delivery serving 30k+ users and 150+ restaurants, fully integrated with the Telegram WebApp SDK to create a seamless in-messenger experience, increasing user retention by 25-30%.
Architected a scalable frontend using Feature-Sliced Design, type-safe React Query data layer, Zod validation, and strategic code splitting to support long-term product growth.

Built a multi-step checkout flow with dish modifiers, promo codes, cashback redemption, and Yandex delivery integration, increasing cart completion by 30% and average order value by 15% through a frictionless returning-user experience.

Implemented advanced multi-layer filtering (cuisine type, halal certification, delivery time, rating) and geo-based restaurant ranking, enabling 3-5 second search results, increasing restaurant click-through rate by 25%, and improving coverage for halal-conscious users.

Developed a partner dashboard for restaurants with CRUD menu management, item availability control (stop-list), and sales analytics, giving restaurants full control without developer involvement, reducing workflow complexity by 35% and eliminating menu-related errors.

tunduk.title: Middle Frontend Developer at Tunduk
tunduk.text: E-Accreditation: the public portal and the staff dashboard, almost entirely on his own.

assist.title: Moves the team
assist.text: Gathers the requirements for the backend, chases design and testing. When the team isn’t around, he’s his own designer, backend and analyst.

kuttukTime.title: Solo run: KuttukTime
kuttukTime.text: His own product: gift certificates from local businesses in a Telegram Mini App. Front end and backend entirely his own, with online payments.
did: Built a Telegram Mini App for buying and gifting gift certificates from local venues: the buyer pays through Finik, gets an 8-digit code with a QR and gifts it to a friend in a chat; the venue's owner redeems it at the counter.

Developed the backend on NestJS, PostgreSQL and TypeORM: Telegram initData signature check (HMAC-SHA256) with JWT, roles for buyers, venue owners and admins, every route closed unless explicitly public.

Integrated Finik payments with his own request signer on node:crypto and a webhook that verifies signatures and audits every request; SELECT … FOR UPDATE makes repeated deliveries harmless — one payment, one certificate.
Implemented weekly payouts to venues: a report computed in SQL in Bishkek time, two independent guards against paying twice, and bot notifications to owners.
Covered the backend with unit, property-based (fast-check) and integration tests against a real PostgreSQL in Testcontainers; CI on GitHub Actions runs lint, types, tests and npm audit.
Built the Mini App on React 19, TypeScript and TanStack Query with Feature-Sliced Design: venue catalog, checkout, an owner's cabinet with QR scanning and an admin panel.

substitution.title: Substitution: on in a backend role
substitution.text: In progress… Java, Node.js, NestJS, SQL and PostgreSQL.

Coaches.title: In the coaches' words
Coaches.lead: What the people he played under say about him.

dinara.name: Dinara Bakirova
dinara.role: Director of Peaksoft, his direct manager
quote: Despite his age, Alisher quickly started working on real projects and handled his tasks with confidence.
I always liked that he approaches work calmly, learns fast and knows how to see tasks through to the result.

dina.name: Dina Ruslan
quote: He proved to be an independent specialist: he calmly takes on tasks and sees them through to the result without constant supervision.
He also showed initiative in optimisation: he worked on the performance, accessibility and usability of interfaces, and it made a noticeable difference in the metrics.

codifyLms.description: CRM and LMS for training centres: homework with a code editor, leaderboards and coins, reports to parents over WhatsApp.

codifyGo.description: Micro-lessons in HTML, CSS and cybersecurity: a code editor right in the browser, levels and streaks, a subscription and an olympiad for schoolchildren.

virtualAccelerate.description: A platform for accelerators: startup selection on a kanban board, investor voting, a form builder and 8 languages including RTL.

jobCodify.description: A careers platform: jobs, courses, an AI résumé helper and a sandbox for running code in the browser.

codifyAcademy.description: A site for programming, design and management courses for children and adults: enrolment, a free lesson and a career aptitude test.

codifyTeens.description: A landing page for a coding academy for ages 7–17 in three languages: a fee calculator, a map and an application form.

startupNation.description: The landing page of Central Asia’s largest hackathon: registration, speakers, mentors and the prize fund.

codifyLab.description: A development studio’s site: case studies and services from a CMS, a brief form with attachments, Russian and English.

alphaCargo.description: Cargo between Kyrgyzstan and Russia: shipment tracking by waybill, a rate calculator and a contract wizard for businesses.

shine.description: An admin panel for an aesthetic clinic: doctors, procedures, reviews and news with a rich text editor.

peaksoftHouse.description: An IT course site: online enrolment, course pages, student projects and an admin panel for two offices.

bilingual.description: English testing: 9 question types, voice recording and anti-cheating protection.

airbnb.description: Home rentals in Kyrgyzstan: filters and search, moderated listings, favourites.

healthCheck.description: A medical service: booking a doctor in five steps, test results online and doctors’ schedules for the admin.

peaksoftLms.description: A platform for managing courses, students and teachers: editors for course materials, graded assignments and importing students from Excel.

gadgetarium.description: An online gadget store: catalogue, comparison, wishlist, Stripe checkout and a product admin.
